lessonTitle: Fibonacci numbers and the golden ratio
lessonTitleEnglish: Fibonacci numbers and the golden ratio

stages.headline: Welcome! 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13… Each number is the sum of the two before it. These Fibonacci numbers hide in sunflowers and shells.
stages.headlineEnglish: Welcome! 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13… Each number is the sum of the two before it. These Fibonacci numbers hide in sunflowers and shells.

stages.headline: Ratios of neighbouring numbers get closer to the golden ratio φ ≈ 1.618, loved by artists and architects.
